evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: The owned/rented opposition frames intelligence as a property relation with proportional cost-benefit logic — what you keep versus what you pay to use — enacting market-pricing relationality.

evidence.quote: The substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Commodity/asset distinction performs proportionality: one thing is fungible and priced, the other is retained value — a cost-benefit allocation of relational worth.
